note: Both are owed, and telling them apart is not cosmetic: `dead` means re-arm from that state without reseeding it, and `wedged` means a process is STILL RUNNING and must be stopped first, or arming is starting a second watcher beside a live one (quince#50). One instruction for two situations is the same defect one level up — the finding that split `dead` from `wedged` in the first place.
expect: OWED  novkostya/quince — open PRs, watch=dead. Re-arm from that state; do NOT reseed it.
OWED  novkostya/quince-devlog — open PRs, watch=wedged. Run "forge-watch stop --repo novkostya/quince-devlog" first, then arm.
